title: Raubüberfall vor Wohnhaus – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen

extraction.summaryEn: Three unknown men attacked a man with a knife in front of a residential building at around 00:30 and stole his shoulder bag before fleeing. A related earlier report describes a 36-year-old stabbed near a kiosk on the same street, who was robbed of cash and an ID document.
